_notice: Seed assumptions from the team build spec. VERIFY items must be checked against current official sources before the demo.

fares.source: team build spec seed values (VERIFY against BRTA / DMTCL notices)

leguna.VERIFY: flat fares per line in seed.json

cng.VERIFY: current CNG rates; not in the team spec, added because the problem statement names CNGs as unmetered connectors

_rushHours_assumption: Dhaka office peak windows (Asia/Dhaka time); used when the user does not set rush hour explicitly

boardWait._assumption: bus and metro waits from the spec; leguna and rickshaw waits are team assumptions

rush._assumption: leguna rush multiplier not in spec; set equal to bus

rain._assumption: leguna and walk rain multipliers not in spec

heavyRain._assumption: team assumption, not in spec: heavy rain (rainSeverity 'heavy') slows road modes more and takes CNG and leguna off the road in the rain zone (small engines stall in waterlogging); rickshaws and buses keep running; metro unaffected

ranking._maxDfsNodes: safety limit on DFS work; if reached the result is marked SEARCH_INCOMPLETE (never reached on the seed network)

alerts._assumption: spec says hard = 'edge broken/heavy penalty': blockade, construction and waterlogging break road edges; gridlock doubles time
